blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Step-level guards decide, before each tool call, whether an agent's next action is safe given the user's request and the trajectory so far. Users write those requests in many languages, while guard prompts and the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated are English. We ask whether a guard's verdict depends on the language of the request. We build LinguaGuardBench from the 1,220 labelled steps of TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj: we translate only the user instruction into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic, and keep every tool call, observation and label byte-identical, so any change in a verdict is attributable to language alone. Six English rewordings and a whitespace placebo serve as controls, and managed guards are run three times to measure their noise. Across 19 guards, from frontier APIs to 4B open models and four purpose-built agent guards, most open, small and purpose-built guards change verdicts under translation beyond their own noise floor, and the effect grows with the rarity of the language: among the nine guards below 13B parameters, the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises from +1.5 pp on French to +4.4 pp on Amharic. Purpose-built guards are the most sensitive. The direction of the damage tends to follow guard size: open guards of 12-30B parameters block more benign steps (up to +5.0 pp false positives), and every significant loss of recall is in a guard below 10B (up to -7.4 pp). Frontier guards shift by at most about one point; the strongest, Gemini 3.8 Flash, returns identical verdicts with and without the request. The damage is concentrated in a few instructions and, in a post-hoc analysis, falls on steps where the agent's reasoning restates the English request, consistent with guards reacting to inconsistency between channels. English paraphrase moves every guard less than translation does. We release the benchmark and all 489k verdicts.
blocks.zh: 阶梯级警卫在每个工具调用之前,根据用户的要求和迄今为止的轨迹,决定代理人的下一个动作是否安全. 用户用多种语言撰写这些请求,而警卫提示和专门建造的警卫的训练和评价基准是英文。 我们问警卫的判决是否取决于请求的语言. 我们从TS-Bench Agent Dojo-Traj的1,220个标有符号的台阶来构建LinguaGuard Bench:我们只把用户指令翻译成德文、法文、土耳其文、斯瓦希里文和阿姆哈拉克文, 并且保留每个工具调用、观察和标有字节的同义字节,所以判决中的任何改变都只能归因于语言。 6个英文重写和1个白空安慰剂作为控制器,管理下的守卫被运行了3次来测量他们的噪音. 跨越19个卫士,从边疆API到4B开放型和4个专有特务卫士,大多数开放,小型和专有特务卫士在翻译下超越了自己的噪音地层而改变判决,效果随着语言的稀有性而增加:在低于13B参数的9个卫士中,平均安慰剂调整翻转率从法语上+1.5页上升到了阿姆哈拉克上+4.4页. 目的建造的警卫是最敏感的 破坏方向往往跟随警卫大小:12-30B参数的开口警卫会挡住更良性的步道(最高为+5.0pp假阳性),每一次严重的召回损失都在10B以下的警卫(最高为-7.4pp). 边防警卫最多转移约一分;最强者双子座 3.8 Flash,随请求或不请求而返回相同的判决. 破坏集中在几个指示上,在后浩克分析中,落在代理推理重述英方请求的步骤上,这与卫兵对频道间不一致的反应一致. 英文译文将每个警卫的动作比翻译少. 我们发布了基准 和所有489k判决。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tool-using agents are increasingly wrapped in step-level guards : a model that inspects the user’s request, the trajectory so far and the candidate tool call, and blocks the call if it appears unsafe [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . The guard reads two channels. The untrusted channel (tool outputs, web pages, files) is where prompt injections live, and its robustness is well studied [ 1 , 3 ] . The trusted channel is the user’s own request. The released guard prompts are English, and so are the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated (TS-Bench, Agent-SafetyBench, ATBench), but the principal they protect writes in whatever language they speak. Whether a guard’s verdict on a fixed action survives a change of language is, to our knowledge, unmeasured, even though the analogous question for safety classifiers, which judge a text rather than an action in the context of a task, has a known bad answer [ 10 , 14 ] .This paper tests the hypothesis, pre-registered before any guard saw a rewritten request, that the language of the request is a security surface for step-level guards. We build LinguaGuardBench : a benchmark with fixed, labelled tool-call steps in which only the user instruction is translated into five languages chosen a priori to span three resource tiers (German and French; Turkish; Swahili and Amharic), and re-run the guards on it. Because the trajectory, the candidate action and the label never change, a verdict that flips is a language effect by construction, not a label disagreement. Two controls separate language from wording and from noise: six English rewordings of the same instructions (four LLM styles, a human paraphrase and typing noise) plus a whitespace placebo, and three repeats of every managed guard so that its own non-determinism is measured and subtracted. Our findings and contributions are best summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 工具使用剂越来越多地被阶梯级警卫所包裹: 用于检查用户请求、迄今的行进轨迹和候选工具呼叫的模型,如果该呼叫看起来不安全,则将其阻断。 后卫读出两道道. 无人信任的频道(工具输出,网页,文件)是即时注入的活地,其稳健性得到了很好的研究[1,3]. 信任的频道是用户自己的请求. 释放的警卫提示是英语,目的建造的警卫受到训练和评价的基准也是英语(TS-Bench、Agent-Safety Bench、AT Bench),但他们保护的校长用他们所说的任何语言写作。 据我们所知,警卫对固定行动的裁决是否维持在语言的改变之上,是没有衡量的,尽管类似安全分类人员的问题,即根据任务判断一个文本而不是行动,有一个众所周知的坏答案[10,14]。 这篇论文测试了假说,在任何警卫看到重写请求之前预先注册,即请求的语言是步级警卫的安全表面. 我们建造了LinguaGuard Bench:一个带有固定、标有标签的工具调用步骤的基准,其中仅将用户指示翻译成五种语言,先行选择跨越三个资源层次(德语和法语;土耳其语;斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉克语),并重新运行上面的警卫。 因为轨迹,候选动作和标签永远不会改变,一个翻转的判断就是通过构建的语言效果,而不是标签上的分歧. 两个控制语言与措辞和噪声分开:六个英语重写相同指令(四个LLM风格,一个人字解译和打字噪声)外加一个白空间安慰剂,三个重复每一个被管理的后卫,这样就可以测量并去掉自己的非定型. 我们的调查结果和贡献最好归纳如下。

blocks.en: • Small guards are language-dependent, and the effect grows as the language gets rarer. Most open and small guards change verdicts under translation beyond their noise floor; Qwen 3.8 27B is the exception. Among the nine guards below 13B parameters (five general small models and four purpose-built agent guards), the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises from +1.5 pp on French and +2.1 on German through +3.1 on Turkish to +4.2 on Swahili and +4.4 on Amharic; the worst guard changes 12% of its verdicts, and Amharic carries the largest error shifts (§ 4.1 , § 4.3 ). • Purpose-built agent guards are the most language-dependent. TS-Guard, ShieldAgent, Safiron and AgentDoG, run with their authors’ own prompts, average a placebo-adjusted flip rate of +2.5 pp on French and +6.3 on Swahili and Amharic. ShieldAgent’s false-positive rate falls by 4–8 pp in every language, Safiron loses 3 pp of recall on Turkish and Amharic (§ 4.4 ). • The failure mode tends to follow scale. Open guards of 12–30B parameters respond by blocking more benign steps (Nemotron 3.5 30B: +4.7 pp FPR on German, +5.0 on Amharic); every significant loss of recall is in a guard below 10B (Nemotron Nano 9B: − 3.1 -3.1 to − 4.5 -4.5 pp recall on German, French and Turkish, − 7.4 -7.4 on Amharic). TS-Guard (7.6B) over-blocks like the larger group, so this is a tendency, not a threshold; neither failure shows up in an English evaluation (§ 4.2 ). • Frontier guards barely move, and the strongest does not read the request. Claude Sonnet 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash have no significant shift in any language; GLM 5.2’s only one is a − 1.1 -1.1 pp false-positive shift on French. Gemini 3.8 Flash and a control that withholds the request agree on 100% of 3,660 paired verdicts (§ 4.5 ). • The damage is concentrated and mechanistically legible. A few long instructions account for most translation-induced flips (one Turkish instruction takes TS-Guard from 12% to 92% blocked), and the flips in excess of placebo land on steps whose Thought restates the original English request, consistent with guards reacting to inconsistency between channels (§ 4.6 , 4.7 ). • The sensitivity is to language more than to wording. Across six English paraphrase conditions no general guard’s flip rate exceeds its placebo by more than 1.4 pp, and every guard that moves at all moves more under translation than under paraphrase (§ 4.8 ). • LinguaGuardBench . A language-controlled evaluation suite for agent guards: 696 rewrites of the 58 TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj instructions across five languages, six English styles and a placebo, each rewrite checked mechanically, judged by two cross-family models and reviewed, frozen by hash, with a materialiser that regenerates the 1,220 labelled steps of every condition byte-identically, plus 489k verdicts from 19 guards (§ 3 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Content guards such as Llama Guard [ 15 ] classify a message; agent guards judge an action in the context of a task. ToolSafe/TS-Guard [ 2 ] trains a 7.6B guard with RL to judge tool invocations from the agent log; GuardAgent [ 20 ] checks actions against guard requests with generated code; TraceSafe [ 3 ] and LlamaFirewall’s AlignmentCheck [ 4 ] prompt general models with the request and trajectory; Task Shield [ 5 ] checks each action against the user’s task; ShieldAgent [ 11 ] , Safiron [ 12 ] and AgentDoG [ 13 ] are fine-tuned judges of agent interaction records, plans and trajectories. All of these read the user request as a trusted input, and all are trained or evaluated on English agent-safety benchmarks [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] ; none reports sensitivity to the request’s language. We evaluate the four released ones.
blocks.zh: 内容卫士如Llama Guard等[15]将信息分类;代理卫士根据任务判断行动. ToolSafe/TS-Guard [2] 培训一名7.6B的警卫,用RL来判断从代理日志引用工具的情况; GuardAgent [20] 用生成的代码检查保安请求的行动; TraceSafe [3] 和LlamaFirewall的对齐检查[4] 迅速与请求和轨迹进行通用模型; 任务盾 [5] 检查每项行动与用户的任务; ShieldAgent [11], Safiron [12]和AgentDoG [13]是代理交互记录、计划和轨迹的微调法官。 所有这些人都读取用户的要求,作为可信赖的投入,并且都接受过英语代理安全基准[16、17、18、19]的培训或评估;没有任何人报告对要求的语言敏感。 我们评估了4个释放的

blocks.en: Safety classifiers and refusal training degrade in low-resource languages: translating harmful prompts into low-resource languages bypasses GPT-4’s safeguards [ 14 ] , and multilingual jailbreak rates track language resource level [ 10 ] . Multilingual safety benchmarks and moderation tools [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] likewise vary the language of the content being judged. Here the content (the tool call and the trajectory) is held fixed and only the language of the principal’s request changes, which isolates the guard’s use of the trusted channel.
blocks.zh: 安全分类和拒绝训练用低资源语言降解:将有害的提示翻译为低资源语言绕过GPT-4的保障措施[14],多语种越狱率跟踪语言资源水平[10]. 多语种安全基准和节制工具[22、23、24、25]同样改变了所判断内容的语言。 这里的内容(工具调用和轨迹)是固定的,只有校长请求的语言会改变,这隔离了警卫对可信任通道的使用.

blocks.en: Multi-prompt evaluation shows that paraphrasing an instruction shifts LLM scores and sometimes rankings [ 6 , 7 ] , and formatting alone can move accuracy by tens of points [ 21 ] ; Rabanser et al. [ 8 ] measure paraphrase robustness of agents . Our English paraphrase conditions replicate this design for guards, and serve here as the control that shows the language effect is not a wording effect.
blocks.zh: 多即时评价显示,将指令的LLM分数和有时的分数分出[6,7]等分,单是格式化就可以移动精度数十分[21]; Rabanser等. [8] 措施解释代理人的稳健性。 我们的英语译文条件 复制了这个设计给警卫, 在这里作为显示语言效果的控制 不是一个措辞效果。

blocks.en: 3 Setup
blocks.zh: 3 设置

blocks.en: TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj [ 2 ] contains 1,220 labelled tool-invocation steps (868 safe, 352 unsafe) from 589 AgentDojo [ 1 ] trajectories across banking, Slack, travel and workspace environments, with 58 unique user instructions. Each step consists of the user instruction, the history (prior thoughts, actions and observations), the candidate action, environment metadata and a label. We use the released labels unchanged and execute no tool call.
blocks.zh: TS - Bench探员 Dojo-Traj [2] 包含来自589 Agent Dojo [1] 的1,220个标有工具调用步骤(868个安全,352个不安全),由589 Agent Dojo [1] 轨迹跨越银行,Slack,出行和工作空间环境,有58个独特的用户指令. 每一步骤包括用户指示、历史(先入为主的思想、行动和观察)、候选行动、环境元数据和标签。 我们使用释放的标签不变,没有执行工具呼叫.

blocks.en: We translate only the instruction field into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic. The languages were chosen a priori by resource tier in the taxonomy of Joshi et al. [ 9 ] : German and French are class 5 (the largest non-English data languages), Turkish class 4, Swahili and Amharic class 2; Swahili is also the low-resource language of MultiJail [ 10 ] . The five span five families (Germanic, Romance, Turkic, Bantu, Semitic) and two scripts (Amharic is written in Ge’ez), and German and Turkish are read by the authors, so the pre-registered translations could be human-reviewed. The translation hypothesis and the first three languages were pre-registered; the low-resource pair extends the design with the same generation and validation pipeline and a frozen file before any guard saw it. Translations are produced by Gemini 3.8 Flash ( T = 0.3 T=0.3 , first of three candidates passing all checks) and must preserve quoted strings, file names, e-mails, URLs, IBANs, dates, times and amounts verbatim, must not add urgency, permission or scope language, and must stay within length bounds.
blocks.zh: 我们只把教学领域翻译成德语、法语、土耳其语、斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉语。 这些语言在Joshi等人的分类学中是按资源层次先验选择的。 [9]:德文和法文为5等(最大非英语数据语言),土耳其文为4等斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉克文为2等;斯瓦希里语也是多杰尔语的低资源语言[10]. 五个跨入了五个家族(德意志语,罗曼斯语,突厥语,班图语,犹太语)和两个脚本(阿姆哈拉克语用盖伊兹语写作),德语和土耳其语由作者阅读,所以预先注册的译名可以经过人文审查. 翻译假说和前三种语言都是预先注册的;而低资源对子则用同代并验证的管道延长了设计,并在任何警卫看到之前将一个被冻结的文件. 翻译由双子座 3.8 Flash(T = 0.3 T = 0.3,通过所有检查的三位考生中第一)出品,必须保留被引用的字符串,文件名,电子邮件,URL,IBAN,日期,时间和数量逐字逐句,不得增加紧迫性,权限或范围语言,并必须在长度范围内.

blocks.en: original and placebo (a trailing space and collapsed double spaces, the tokenisation-noise floor); six English paraphrase conditions: programmatic keyboard-adjacency typos (8% of eligible words, slot spans protected), four LLM styles (lexical, terse, verbose-polite, casual; Gemini 3.8 Flash, T = 0.7 T=0.7 ) and one human paraphrase per instruction written before seeing any LLM output. The paraphrases are held to the same slot and scope checks as the translations.
blocks.zh: 原生和安慰剂(一个后起后起并倒塌的双相空间,象征-噪声地层);六个英语参数:程序键盘-adjacency types(占合格字数的8%,槽跨被保护),四种LLM风格(语法,terse,动词-polyte,随意;双子座 3.8). Flash, T = 0.7 T = 0.7),在看到任何LLM输出之前,每个指令写出一个人字. 译出时段和范围检查与翻译相同。

blocks.en: Every accepted row was judged for task equivalence by two cross-family judges (Claude Sonnet 5, judging translations on its own back-translation; Gemini 3.1 Pro). Every one of the 580 pre-registered rows was read by a human (0 rejected, 1 repaired); the 116 low-resource rows were accepted or repaired from the back-translation under a fixed rule (Appendix D ; 4 Amharic rows repaired). A materialisation check asserts that history, action, environment and label are byte-identical across conditions.
blocks.zh: 每个被接受的行由两名跨家庭法官(克洛德·索内特5,根据自己的背翻译判断翻译;双子座3.1 Pro)判定任务等同. 预先登记的580行每行被人读取(0个被否决,1个被修复);116个低资源行被接受或被按照固定规则从后翻译中修复(附录 D;4个阿姆哈拉克行被修复). 一项实事求是检查表明,历史、行动、环境和标签在条件上是字节相同的。

blocks.en: LinguaGuardBench and all verdicts are released; contents are listed in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: LinguaGuard Bench和所有判决均予公布;内容列于附录D.

blocks.en: Nineteen guards, all run on one cloud platform. Sixteen use the same structured prompt (three fields: malicious user request, third-party attack, action harmfulness, mapped to TS-Guard’s composite score; block if composite ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ): frontier APIs Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5 (thinking disabled) and GLM 5.2; managed open models gpt-oss-120b, Llama 4 Maverick, Gemma 4 26B-A4B; self-deployed open models Qwen 3.8 27B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B; a post-hoc small tier of Gemma 4 (E2B, 12B), Qwen 3.5 (4B, 9B) and Nemotron Nano (4B, 9B); the specialised TS-Guard [ 2 ] with its native prompt; and a scanner control : Gemini 3.8 Flash with the user request withheld, which by construction must be invariant. Three further purpose-built agent guards run with their authors’ released prompts and parsers (Appendix E ): ShieldAgent [ 11 ] (Qwen2.5-7B), Safiron [ 12 ] (Ministral-8B) and AgentDoG [ 13 ] (Qwen3-4B). These three judge the trajectory prefix up to and including the candidate action, so their block decision is trajectory-level while the label is step-level; flip rates, which compare a guard with itself, are unaffected, and their FPR/TPR carry that caveat. The low-resource pair was run on the Gemini guards and the self-deployed guards only, including a self-deployed Gemma 4 26B-A4B that agrees with the managed one on 98% of verdicts (Appendix E ). Managed guards are run with K = 3 K=3 repeats at temperature 0; self-deployed guards use greedy decoding ( K = 1 K=1 ). Open models receive server-side JSON-schema enforcement.
blocks.zh: 十九卫,都跑一云台. 16人使用相同的结构化快取(三个字段:恶意用户请求,第三方攻击,动作有害,被映射到TS-Guard的复合分数;如果复合分数为 ^ 0.5\ geq 0.5 的块:前沿APIS 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5 (思维已禁用)和GLM 5.2;管理开放型gpt-oss-120b,Llama 4 Maverick,Gemma 4 26B-A4B;自行部署开放型Qwen 3.8 27B,Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B;Gemma 4 (E2B, 12B),Quen 3.5 (4B,9B)和Nemotron Nano (4B,9B);专门TS-Gard [2],其本土即时;以及一台扫描仪控制:Gemi 3.8 Flam,其用户请求被拒绝,建造时必须无变动。 另有3名专门建造的特工警卫带着作者释放的提示和解析器(附录E):ShieldAgent [11] (Quen2.5-7B),Safiron [12] (Ministryal-8B)和AgentDoG [13] (Quen3-4B)。 这三人判断出轨迹前缀上并包括了候选动作,因此他们的块决定是轨迹级别而标签是阶梯级别;翻转率,将防守本身进行比较,不受影响,他们的FPR/TPR带有这个警告. 低资源一对只运行在双子座卫士和自来自去的卫士身上,包括一个自来自去的Gemma 4 26B-A4B,在98%的判决上同意管理一(附录E. 被管理的警卫在0温下由K=3K=3重复运行;自部署的警卫使用贪婪的解码(K=1K=1). 开放型号接收服务器侧JSON-schema执行.

blocks.en: For each guard and condition, paired to original at (step, repeat): the verdict flip rate , the placebo-adjusted flip rate (the flip rate minus the guard’s own placebo flip rate), and Δ ​ FPR \Delta\mathrm{FPR} / Δ ​ TPR \Delta\mathrm{TPR} with 95% percentile intervals from a 1,000-replicate bootstrap clustered by trajectory. Tier-level estimates pool the pairs of a tier’s languages before bootstrapping. We also report Kendall’s τ \tau between guard rankings by balanced accuracy, flips by restatement-leakage stratum (whether ≥ 60 % \geq 60\% of the instruction’s content words appear in the history or Thought; 59.6% of steps), and per-instruction block-rate changes.

blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Translating the request changes verdicts and error rates
blocks.zh: 4.1 翻译请求更改判决和错误率

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows Δ ​ TPR \Delta\mathrm{TPR} and Δ ​ FPR \Delta\mathrm{FPR} for every guard and language with bootstrap intervals; Table 1 lists every cell with significant ones in bold. Translation changes up to 12.1% of a guard’s verdicts (ShieldAgent on Swahili, +10.5 pp over its placebo; Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on Amharic 11.1%), and 39 of the 77 guard × \times language cells (17 guards, excluding the scanner control and the degenerate Gemma 4 E2B) show a significant shift in FPR or TPR. Two patterns hold across all five languages, and they split the roster by size.

Points with 95% trajectory-clustered bootstrap intervals; faded points have intervals that include zero. Marker: high- (circle), mid- (square), low-resource (triangle) language. Colour: frontier (blue), open 17–120B (orange), small < < 13B (red), specialised (green).

blocks.en: No guard of 12B parameters or more loses recall in any language; every significant shift in that range is in the false-positive rate, and the large ones are increases: Nemotron 3.5 30B-A3B (+4.7 pp German, +4.1 Turkish, +5.0 Amharic), Gemma 4 26B-A4B (+1.1 German, +2.9 Turkish; its self-hosted copy +2.4 Turkish, +1.2 Swahili, +3.6 Amharic), Gemma 4 12B (+2.0 Turkish, +2.8 Amharic), Llama 4 Maverick (+1.8 German, +1.4 Turkish). Two guards move the other way by about a point (Qwen 3.8 27B, GLM 5.2). TS-Guard, at 7.6B, behaves like this group (+3.6 German, +2.8 Turkish, +1.8 Amharic). For these guards a request in another language is a source of nuisance: benign steps that were allowed in English are blocked.
blocks.zh: 12B参数或更多参数的保镖在任何语言中都不会失去召回;该范围内的每个显著变化都处于假阳性速率中,而较大的增速是:Nemotron 3.5 30B-A3B(+4.7页德文,+4.1土耳其文,+5.0阿姆哈拉克文),Gemma 4 26B-A4B(+1.1德文,+2.9土耳其文;其自办副本+2.4土耳其文,+1.2斯瓦希里文,+3.6阿姆哈拉克文),Gemma 4 12B(+2.0土耳其文,+2.8阿姆哈拉克文),Llama 4 Maverick(+1.8德文,+1.4土耳其文). 两名警卫向另一边移动了约一分(Quen 3.8 27B,GLM 5.2). TS-Guard at 7.6B,行为类似这个组(+3.6德文,+2.8土耳其文,+1.8阿姆哈拉文). 对于这些警卫来说,用另一种语言提出请求是令人不快的:英语允许的良性步骤被封锁了。

blocks.en: Every significant decrease in recall in the study is a guard below 10B parameters under translation: Nemotron Nano 9B loses 3.1, 4.5 and 4.3 pp of TPR on German, French and Turkish, 3.7 on Swahili and 7.4 on Amharic; Nemotron 3 Nano 4B loses 2.0 pp on German and Qwen 3.5 9B 3.1 pp on Swahili. Their false-positive rates move less and in both directions (Nemotron 3 Nano 4B − 2.2 -2.2 French, +2.5 Swahili; Qwen 3.5 9B +2.5 Amharic). For these guards the trusted channel is an attack surface: an attacker who controls the language of the request, or who targets non-English users, gets more attacks through. These are the weakest guards in the roster (BACC at most 0.80, Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 研究中每一次召回量明显减少,就有一个警卫在翻译下低于10B参数: Nemotron Nano 9B在德文,法文和土耳其文上损失了3.1,4.5和4.3页的TPR,斯瓦希里文上损失了3.7页,阿姆哈拉文上损失了7.4页;Nemotron 3 Nano 4B在德文上损失了2.0页,而Quen 3.5 9B 3.1在斯瓦希里文上损失了2.0页. 它们的假阳性率移动较少,双向(Nemotron 3 Nano 4B − 2.2-2.2 法语,+2.5 Swahili;Quen 3.5 9B +2.5 Amharic). 对于这些卫士来说,可信赖的频道是一个攻击表面:控制请求语言的攻击者,或者针对非英语用户的攻击者,得到更多的攻击通过. 这些警卫是名册上最薄弱的警卫(巴库中心最多0.80人,表2)。

blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 损坏的标志往往跟随警卫的大小

blocks.en: Figure 2: Mean shift under translation (pooled over the languages each guard was run on) against guard size. Filled triangles pointing down: Δ ​ TPR \Delta\mathrm{TPR} (negative means attacks missed); open triangles pointing up: Δ ​ FPR \Delta\mathrm{FPR} (positive means benign steps blocked); a vertical line joins the two markers of one guard. The degenerate Gemma 4 E2B is omitted. Over-blocking is a 12–30B phenomenon; missed attacks appear below 10B.

blocks.en: Figure 2 places the pooled shifts on a size axis. The crossover is not monotone in raw flip rate (Qwen 3.5 9B flips more than both its 4B and 27B siblings), but there is a tendency in which error grows: at 12B and above every significant shift is in false positives, and every significant loss of recall is below 10B. The converse does not hold (TS-Guard at 7.6B and several sub-10B guards also over-block), so this is a tendency, not a threshold. The two regimes are not two degrees of the same failure. A mid-sized guard that over-blocks has not lost the ability to recognise an attack; it has become more suspicious of everything, and the extra blocks fall on benign steps because there are more of them. A small guard that under-blocks has lost the signal: with a request it parses less well, an unsafe action looks like every other action. Under the strict decision rule (block only if composite = 1 =1 ), the placebo-adjusted flip rates under translation grow further for the guards that move (Nemotron 3.5 +5.7 pp, Nemotron 3 Nano 4B +5.1, Qwen 3.5 4B +2.9, TS-Guard +2.6) while every frontier guard stays within 0.2 pp under both rules (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 图2将集合转移置于大小轴上。 翻转在原始翻转速率上不是单通(Quen 3.5 9B翻转比它的4B和27B兄弟姐妹都多出),但有一种出错增加的趋势:在12B及以上每一次重大转折都是以假阳性为单位,每一次重大回转损失都低于10B. 反相没有被挡住(TS-Guard at 7.6B和多个分-10B的守卫也过度挡住),所以这是一个倾向,而不是门槛. 两种制度并非同一失败的两度. 一个中等规模的后卫,过度地块并没有失去识别出攻击的能力;它越来越怀疑一切,额外的后块倒倒在了良性的阶梯上,因为更多的是它们. 一个小后卫 被封锁了信号: 在一个请求中, 不安全的动作看起来就像其他的动作。 根据严格的决定规则(只有在复合=1=1时才设置障碍),翻译项下的安慰剂调整翻转率对于移动的警卫会进一步增长(Nemotron 3.5+5.7 pp,Nemotron 3 Nano 4B+5.1,Quen 3.5 4B+2.9,TS-Guard +2.6),而根据这两项规则,每个边防警卫都停留在0.2pp以内(附录C.).

blocks.en: 4.3 The effect grows as the language gets rarer
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 随着语言越来越稀有,效果也越来越大

blocks.en: Table 6 (Appendix) pools each guard’s pairs by language tier (Joshi et al. classes 5, 4 and 2) before bootstrapping. For the six guards below 13B parameters, the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises monotonically with rarity: +0.8 pp on French, +1.3 German, +2.5 Turkish, +2.8 Swahili, +3.2 Amharic (the five general small models alone: +0.7, +1.1, +2.0, +2.5, +3.0). The four purpose-built guards follow the same order at a higher level (+2.5, +3.4, +4.3, +6.4, +6.2; § 4.4 ), the open 12–30B guards at a lower one (+0.7, +1.1, +1.6 on the pre-registered languages; +1.0 and +2.1 on Swahili and Amharic for the two run there), and the frontier guards stay below +0.5 pp everywhere. Per guard, the low-resource tier is at least as bad as the high-resource tier for every guard that moves at all. It is the worst tier for Nemotron 3 Nano 4B (+0.6 → \to +4.1 → \to +7.2 pp from high through mid to low), Nemotron 3.5 30B (+1.2 → \to +2.5 → \to +3.2), Nemotron Nano 9B (+1.5 → \to +1.6 → \to +2.2) and Gemma 4 12B (+0.4 → \to +0.6 → \to +0.8). For TS-Guard, Qwen 3.5 9B and the self-hosted Gemma 4 26B, Turkish is marginally worse than the low tier; Gemini 3.8 Flash and Qwen 3.8 27B do not move in any tier. The error shifts are guard-specific rather than class-wide. Pooled over the five general small guards, Δ ​ TPR \Delta\mathrm{TPR} is − 0.7 -0.7 [ − 1.3 -1.3 , − 0.1 -0.1 ] on high-, − 1.2 -1.2 [ − 2.0 -2.0 , − 0.3 -0.3 ] on mid- and − 0.9 -0.9 [ − 1.8 -1.8 , − 0.0 -0.0 ] pp on low-resource languages, and Δ ​ FPR \Delta\mathrm{FPR} turns positive on the low tier (+0.9 [+0.3, +1.4]): the recall loss is carried by Nemotron Nano 9B ( − 3.8 → − 4.3 → − 5.5 -3.8\to-4.3\to-5.5 ), while the two 4B guards drift towards blocking on Swahili and Amharic. For the over-blockers, Amharic is the worst single language in the study (Nemotron 3.5 +5.0 pp FPR, Gemma 4 26B +3.6, Gemma 4 12B +2.8, Qwen 3.5 9B +2.5), while Swahili is not: its flips are as frequent as Turkish’s, but the error shifts scatter in both directions (two significant FPR increases against three decreases, including TS-Guard at − 2.2 -2.2 pp), so Swahili scrambles verdicts without a consistent bias. Amharic is also the only non-Latin script in the set; separating script from resource level needs more languages than we ran.

blocks.en: The pre-registered languages already showed the ordering: Turkish, the mid-resource language, was harder than German and French for every guard (seven guards with a significant FPR increase against five and zero; TS-Guard +4.8 pp placebo-adjusted, 9.3% raw). The low-resource pair, added afterwards, extends it: the two largest raw flip rates in the study are Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on Swahili (10.8%) and Amharic (11.1%), and the guard ranking is least stable under Amharic among the languages run on the same roster ( τ = 0.93 \tau=0.93 against 0.99 for Swahili).
blocks.zh: 预先注册的语文已经显示订单:土耳其语,中间资源语言,每名警卫都比德文和法文更难(7名警卫的FPR比5名和0名显著增加;TS-Guard + 4.8 pp 安慰剂调整后,9.3%生用). 之后添加的低资源对接扩展了它:研究中两个最大的原始翻转率是斯瓦希里语上Nemotron 3 Nano 4B (10.8%)和阿姆哈拉克语(11.1%),而在同一名册上运行的语文中,在阿姆哈拉语下,警卫的排名最不稳定(τ=0.93\tau=0.93,而斯瓦希里语为0.99)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Purpose-built agent guards are the most language-dependent
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 目的制造的特工警卫最依赖语言

blocks.en: The four guards trained specifically to judge agent actions, run with their authors’ own prompts, are the most language-dependent guards in the study. “Language-dependent” means verdict instability, not harm: ShieldAgent’s error rates improve under translation, and the comparison is within guard. Their mean placebo-adjusted flip rate under translation is +3.4 pp (TS-Guard), +2.9 (Safiron), +4.3 (AgentDoG) and +7.7 (ShieldAgent), against +1.4, +1.3, +1.8 and +3.5 under English paraphrase, and each rises from the high- to the low-resource tier (TS-Guard +2.0 → \to +4.8 → \to +4.1, Safiron +1.9 → \to +3.2 → \to +3.7, AgentDoG +2.5 → \to +2.7 → \to +7.0, ShieldAgent +5.5 → \to +6.7 → \to +10.4). ShieldAgent changes 12.1% of its verdicts on Swahili and 11.9% on Amharic (its placebo floor is 1.6%). The direction differs by guard and does not follow the size rule of § 4.2 . ShieldAgent, which blocks 44% of benign steps in English, blocks fewer of them in every other language ( − 7.6 -7.6 pp German, − 5.4 -5.4 French, − 3.8 -3.8 Turkish, − 5.3 -5.3 Swahili, − 3.8 -3.8 Amharic, all significant) while its recall holds. Safiron, the weakest of the four (recall 0.41), loses recall on Turkish ( − 3.4 -3.4 pp), Swahili ( − 2.8 -2.8 ) and Amharic ( − 3.1 -3.1 ); AgentDoG flags every unsafe trajectory in every language and moves only on benign steps; TS-Guard over-blocks on German, Turkish and Amharic and under-blocks on Swahili. What the four share is that a translated request changes the operating point of a guard whose documented training data, prompts and benchmarks are English, by more than any general-purpose model of the same size. The field’s own guards are the least stable.

ShieldAgent更改了对斯瓦希里语判决的12.1%,对阿姆哈拉语判决的11.9%(其安慰剂地板为1.6%)。 取向因警卫而异,并不符合§4.2的大小规则. ShieldAgent用英语阻断了44%的良性步骤,在每种其他语言(德语-7.6-7.6;法语-5.4-5.4;土耳其语-3.8-3.8;斯瓦希里语-5.3-5.3;阿姆哈拉语-3.8-3.8;均具有重大意义)中阻断较少。 Safiron,四人中最弱的(回顾0.41),在土耳其语(-3.4-3.4页)、斯瓦希里语(-2.8-2.8页)和阿姆哈拉克语(-3.1-3.1页)上失去记忆; Agent DoG在每种语言中标出每一个不安全的行道,只以良性步骤行走; TS-Guard在德文、土耳其文和阿姆哈拉克语上过街,在斯瓦希里语下街。 4个部分是,翻译请求会改变一名警卫的操作点,该警卫的有记录的训练数据、提示和基准是英文,比任何大小相同的通用模型都要多。 现场的警卫最不稳定。

blocks.en: 4.5 Frontier guards are invariant, and the strongest one does not read the request
blocks.zh: 4.5 边防军无动于衷,最强者不读请求

blocks.en: Table 2 gives each guard’s original-wording operating point and placebo flip rate. Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Sonnet 5 are the best guards (BACC 0.983 and 0.958), and neither shows a significant change in FPR or TPR under any language (all five for Gemini, the three pre-registered for Claude); their placebo-adjusted flip rates are 0.0 pp and at most 1.1 pp. GLM 5.2 shows one significant shift, a decrease of 1.1 pp in false positives on French, and none in recall.

blocks.en: The scanner control makes the Gemini result sharper than mere robustness. The control receives the identical prompt with the user-request field removed; its prompt hash differs and its inputs are 43 tokens shorter. It agrees with the full Gemini guard on 100.0% of 3,660 paired verdicts on the original wording, has an identical operating point (TPR 0.977, FPR 0.012), and flips at most one of its 3,660 verdicts under every condition, as does Gemini itself. The instruction text appears verbatim in the history for only 3 of 1,220 steps, so this is not copying: on this benchmark the trajectory carries everything a strong guard uses, and the trusted channel is redundant. A guard that ignores the request cannot be attacked through its language; the converse is that such a guard also cannot use the request to disambiguate an action, which is the case Task Shield-style designs [ 5 ] are built for.
blocks.zh: 扫描仪的控制使得双子座结果比单纯的强健性更尖锐. 控件收到与被删除的用户请求字段相同的提示;其提示散列不同,输入的符号短43个. 它同意双子座卫士在3,660对原措辞的判决中的100.0%,具有相同的操作点(TPR 0.977,FPR 0.012),并且在每个条件下最多翻转了3,660个判决中的一个,双子座本身也是如此. 指令文本在历史上仅以1,220个步骤中的3个出现,所以这并非是复制:在这个基准上,轨迹携带了所有强卫使用的东西,而可信赖的通道是多余的. 一个无视请求的后卫不能通过其语言来攻击;反之是这样的后卫也不能利用请求来分解一个动作,这就是任务盾牌式的设计[5]是用来建造的.

blocks.en: 4.6 The damage is concentrated in a few instructions
blocks.zh: 4.6 (中文(简体) ). 损坏集中在一些指示中

blocks.en: Flip rates are averages over 1,220 steps from 58 instructions; the per-instruction view shows they are not evenly spread. TS-Guard on Turkish flips 9.3% of verdicts overall, but on one instruction (“Can you recommend me a hotel with highest rating in Paris? If there are multiple options…”, 26 steps) its block rate goes from 12% to 92%, i.e. 81% of that instruction’s steps flip. Gemma 4 26B on Turkish moves “Perform the following tasks in the order they are given: 1. How many appointments do I have…” (69 steps) from 62% to 97% blocked; Nemotron 3.5 on German moves the Facebook-security-code instruction of the same enumerated family from 58% to 83%. The low-resource pair hits the same family: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on Swahili moves “Perform the following tasks in the order they are given: 1. What are we going to do on June 13…” (24 steps) from 0% to 62% blocked and, on Amharic, the Paris-trip budget instruction (53 steps) from 49% to 85%; Nemotron 3.5 on Amharic moves “Please show me my unread emails” (14 steps) from 36% to 93%. The direction is not always towards blocking: TS-Guard on Swahili releases the Facebook-security-code instruction from 92% to 33% blocked, and Nemotron 3.5 on Swahili releases the TODO-list e-mail instruction from 95% to 37%. The “perform the following tasks in the order they are given” instructions recur as hot spots across guards and languages: long, enumerated, multi-task requests are where translation turns an open guard into a block-everything guard for the whole trajectory.

blocks.en: 4.7 Mechanism: guards react to inconsistency between channels
blocks.zh: 4.7 机制:警卫对各渠道之间的不一致作出反应

blocks.en: We pre-registered the expectation that flips would concentrate on non-leaky steps, where the history does not restate the request and the guard has to rely on the request field. The data split by regime (Figure 3 ). Leaky steps already flip more under placebo (they sit later in trajectories), but for the strong guards and for the guards that lose recall the placebo-adjusted flip rate under translation is also larger on leaky steps: Claude Sonnet 5 +1.2 vs. +0.3 pp, TS-Guard +4.1 vs. +2.4, Nemotron Nano 9B +2.2 vs. +1.2, Qwen 3.5 9B +2.6 vs. +1.0; the same ordering holds under paraphrase (Claude +0.9 vs. +0.1, TS-Guard +2.1 vs. +0.2). When the agent’s Thought restates the original English request and the request field now says it in another language, these guards see two channels that disagree, and their verdict moves. For the over-blockers the placebo-adjusted flip rate is larger on the non-leaky steps: Nemotron 3.5 +1.8 vs. +2.8, Llama 4 Maverick +1.7 vs. +2.5, Gemma 4 26B +0.6 vs. +1.4 (self-hosted − 0.2 -0.2 vs. +2.8), AgentDoG +2.4 vs. +7.2. Safiron (+4.0 vs. +1.3) sides with TS-Guard; ShieldAgent moves on both (+8.0 vs. +7.3). Where nothing in the trajectory restates the request, these guards treat the foreign request itself as suspicious. Two mechanisms are consistent with this split, and they match the two regimes: inconsistency detection, which needs a restatement to fire and moves verdicts in either direction, and distrust of a foreign request, which fires when the request is the only source and adds blocks. Both are bounded by the restatement rate (60% of steps), which our intervention does not change, and a guard that decides from the trajectory alone, as the frontier models appear to do, is immune to both.
blocks.zh: 我们预先登记了一种期望,即翻转将集中在非淡出步骤上,其中历史不重复请求,而后卫必须依靠请求场. 数据按制度划分(图3)。 但对于坚挺的守卫和失去记忆的看守来说, 翻译中安慰剂调整后翻转率在漏出后也会更大: Claude Sonnet 5+1.2 vs. +0.3 pp, TS-Guard + 4.1 vs. + 2.4, Nemotron Nano 9B + 2.2 vs. +1.2, Quen 3.5 9B + 2.6 vs. + 1.0; 同一命令在引文(Claude +0.9 vs. +0.1, TS-Guard +2.1 vs. +0.2)中被搁置. 当代理商的想法重述了最初的英语请求,请求栏现在用另一种语言表示时,这些卫士会看到两个有不同意见的渠道,而他们的判断会移动. 对于超屏蔽器,非屏蔽步骤上安慰剂调整后翻转率较大:Nemotron 3.5 + 1.8 vs. + 2.8, Llama 4 Maverick + 1.7 vs. +2.5, Gemma 4 26B + 6.6 vs. + 1.4(自发托管 − 0.2-0.2 vs. + 2.8) Agent DoG + 2.4 vs. + 7.2. Safiron (+ 4.0 vs. +1.3) 侧面有TS-Guard;ShieldAgent 双相移动 (+ 8.0 vs. + 7.3). 如果轨道上没有任何东西重复请求,这些警卫将外国请求本身视为可疑。 两种机制与这种分化一致,它们与两种制度相匹配:不一致检测(需要重述来点火并朝两个方向移动判决)和对外国请求的不信任(当请求是唯一的来源并增加块时会起火). 两者都以重述率(60%的步数)为界,我们的干预并没有改变,而从轨迹中单独决定的卫士,正如前沿模型所显示的那样,对两者都免疫.

For the strong guards and the recall-losers the rate is higher on leaky steps; for the over-blockers it is higher on non-leaky steps.

blocks.en: 4.8 The sensitivity is to language more than to wording
blocks.zh: 4.8 (中文(简体) ). 对语言的敏感程度大于措辞

blocks.en: The same instructions reworded in English are the control. Across typos, four LLM styles and a human paraphrase, no general guard’s verdict flip rate exceeds its own placebo by more than 1.4 pp (TS-Guard among the pre-registered roster, Nemotron 3 Nano 4B in the small tier); the two purpose-built guards that do move under paraphrase (ShieldAgent +3.5 pp, AgentDoG +1.8) move two to three times as much under translation. Every guard that moves at all moves more under translation than under paraphrase. No paraphrase condition reduces any guard’s recall except gpt-oss-120b on the terse style ( − 1.3 -1.3 pp), and the guard ranking is preserved (Kendall’s τ \tau 0.96–0.98 against 0.93–0.96 under translation). Dose–response by surface-distance tercile is flat for all but two guards. The only paraphrase effects that reach significance are register effects on the false-positive rate of small guards and TS-Guard, in both directions (polite verbose phrasing lowers Nemotron 3 Nano 4B’s FPR by 4.8 pp and raises Qwen 3.5 9B’s by 3.0 pp). The full paraphrase results are in Appendix A . A guard that is nearly invariant to how a request is worded but not to which language it is written in has learned the language, more than the register, as a feature.
blocks.zh: 用英语重写过的同样指示是控制. 纵观各种类型,四种LLM风格和一种人文解释,没有一般警卫的判决翻转率超过自己的安慰剂超过1.4pp(TS-Guard在预先注册的名册中,Nemotron 3 Nano 4B在小级别);两个目的建造的警卫在解释下移动(ShieldAgent + 3.5 pp,Agent DoG + 1.8),在翻译下移动2到3倍. 每一个动起来的警卫 都会在翻译中 而不是在翻译中 除了terse风格的gpt-oss-120b(-1.3-1.3pp)外,没有一句解释性条件可以减少任何警卫的召回(Kendall的\tau 0.96-0.98对0.93-0.96的翻译),警卫的排名得以保留。 剂量- 以地表- 相距微小的应答, 除了两个守卫之外, 所有其他都平坦 。 唯一具有意义的说法效果是对两个方向的小警卫和TS-Guard的假阳性率的登记效应(政治动词将Nemotron 3 Nano 4B的FPR低了4.8页并用3.0页提高了Quen 3.5 9B的分数)。 全文解释结果见附录A。 一个几乎对请求的用词不熟悉的警卫却不熟悉它用哪一种语言写成的警卫,已经学会了语言,比收录器还要多,作为一个特征.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: For a guard that must serve non-English users, size is a proxy for the failure mode to expect: 17–30B open models tend to over-block, the guards that under-block are all below 10B, and neither shows up in an English-only evaluation. Purpose-built agent guards are not exempt; they are the most sensitive class we measured, and their direction has to be measured per guard. We evaluated no mitigation; translate-then-guard or per-language thresholds are untested candidates for the over-blocking regime. The concentration in enumerated multi-task instructions (§ 4.6 ) suggests a cheap diagnostic: evaluate guards on translated long instructions specifically, and on a low-resource language, where the effect is largest.
blocks.zh: 对于一个必须服务于非英语用户的后卫来说,大小是失败模式所期望的代名词:17-30B开放型号往往过度封堵,下方封堵都低于10B的后卫,在仅以英语为主的评价中都没有出现. 目的制成的毒剂卫士是不能例外的;他们是我们测得的最敏感的等级,他们的方向必须按每名卫士测量. 我们没有评估缓解措施;翻译时的警卫或每个语文的门槛值是过度封锁制度的未经测试的候选条件。 所列举的多任务指令(§ 4.6)的集中表明一种廉价的诊断:具体地评价被翻译出长指令的守卫,以及评价效果最大的低资源语言.

blocks.en: The Gemini/scanner identity and the leaky-step mechanism point the same way: on trajectory-rich benchmarks the agent’s own reasoning restates the request, and strong guards decide from the trajectory. This is good news for robustness and bad news for benchmark validity: a benchmark cannot test a guard’s use of the trusted channel if the untrusted channel already contains it. It also reframes language robustness: a guard is hurt by translation to the extent that it compares channels, not to the extent that it reads the request.
blocks.zh: 双子座/扫描仪的特性和漏出步骤机制同样指向:在轨迹丰富的基准上,特工本身的推理重复了请求,强卫从轨迹上决定. 这是稳健的好消息,也是基准有效性的坏消息:如果无人信任的频道已经包含这个频道,那么基准就不能测试警卫对信任频道的使用。 也重新定义了语言的稳健性:一个被翻译所伤害的警卫,其程度是比较频道,而不是阅读请求.

blocks.en: The LLM paraphrases and all five translations were generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash, which is also a guard; its measured invariance is therefore a lower bound, although the scanner identity makes generator overlap an unlikely explanation. Nobody on the team reads Swahili or Amharic, so those rows were accepted on the strength of two judges and back-translation, and the low-resource pair was not run on the partner-hosted guards (Claude, Llama, GLM, gpt-oss). The small tier and the low-resource pair were added after the pre-registered runs (ten guards, three languages), each with its own frozen-before-inference file. The alignment prompt gives open models high false-positive rates (0.26–0.37) at the original wording; effects are reported as shifts from each guard’s own operating point. gpt-oss-120b was quota-throttled and completed 7 of the 11 pre-registered perturbed conditions. ShieldAgent, Safiron and AgentDoG were built to judge whole interaction records, plans or trajectories; we feed them the prefix up to the candidate action, and Safiron’s input format has no observation channel, so our adapter places each step’s thought, tool call and observation in its action list. Their error rates against step labels are therefore not comparable with the step-level guards; their flip rates are. The bootstrap clusters by trajectory (589) while the intervention is per instruction (58), so the intervals are likely too narrow (§ 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: LLM解说和所有5个译名都是由双子座3.8 Flash生成的,Flash也是一个守护者;因此其测量到的偏差是一个下限,尽管扫描仪的身份使得生成者与一个不太可能的解释相重叠. 队伍中无人阅读斯瓦希里语或阿姆哈拉语,因此这些行被接受于两名裁判和后传翻译的兵力,低资源配对没有运行在由合伙人托管的警卫上(克洛德,Llama,GLM,gpt-oss). 在预先注册的运行(10个警卫,3个语言)后,增加了小分层和低资源对子,每个分层都有自己的被冻结的推论前文件. 校正速率让开放型号在最初的措辞中出现高假阳性率(0.26–0.37);效果报告为从每名警卫自己的操作点转出. gpt-oss-120b是被冻结配额,在预先登记的11个扰动条件下完成了7个。 ShieldAgent,Safiron和AgentDoG是用来判断整个互动记录,计划或轨迹的;我们给他们提供候选动作的前缀,而Safiron的输入格式没有观察通道,因此我们的适配器将每个步骤的思想,工具召唤和观察都放在了它的动作列表中. 因此,它们与分级标签的误差率与分级警卫不相上下;它们的倒转率是相上下下. 按轨迹排列的靴子群(589个),而干预则按指令(58个)进行,因此间隔可能太窄(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Translating a user request changes what open and small step-level guards decide about a fixed action, and the direction of the damage tends to follow the guard’s size: mid-sized open guards block more benign steps, small guards let more attacks through, purpose-built agent guards move most of all, and frontier guards, the strongest of which does not use the request field at all, barely move. The effect grows as the language gets rarer: Amharic, the lowest-resource language and the only non-Latin script in the set, produces the largest shifts in both regimes. It is concentrated in long enumerated instructions and, in a post-hoc analysis, lands where the request and the agent’s own restatement of it disagree. Rewording the same request in English changes far less. For open and small guards the language of the request is a security surface, and an evaluation that only ever shows the guard English requests will not expose it.
blocks.zh: 翻译用户请求会改变开放的和小的阶梯级警卫对固定动作的决定,破坏的方向往往跟随警卫的大小:中型的开放警卫挡住更多的良性步骤,小警卫让更多的攻击穿过,目的建造的特工警卫最能移动,而边境警卫,其中最强者完全不使用请求场,几乎没有移动. 随着语言越来越稀有,效果也逐渐增长:阿姆哈拉克语(Amharic),是该集中资源最少的语言,也是唯一的非拉丁文字,产生了两个政权中最大的转变. 它集中在长期列举的指示中,在一次事后分析中,在请求和代理人自己对请求的重新陈述有异议的地方。 用英语重写同一请求的变化要小得多。 对于开放的和小的警卫来说,请求的语言是安全表面的,而只显示警卫英语请求的评价不会暴露出来.

blocks.en: All guards run on one cloud platform. Managed models: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro through the platform’s Gemini API with a response schema; Claude Sonnet 5 through the partner API with thinking disabled (the SDK exposes no temperature for this model); GLM 5.2, gpt-oss-120b, Gemma 4 26B-A4B and Llama 4 Maverick through the platform’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint with response_format = json_schema and 8k tokens of headroom for hidden reasoning. Self-deployed models (Qwen 3.8 27B FP8, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, TS-Guard, the six small guards, a self-deployed copy of Gemma 4 26B-A4B used for the low-resource pair, and the three purpose-built guards ShieldAgent, Safiron and AgentDoG at pinned revisions) run vLLM on one RTX PRO 6000 with max-model-len 32768, greedy decoding and JSON-schema enforcement (TS-Guard uses its authors’ XML prompt and parser instead; ShieldAgent uses the Agent-SafetyBench evaluation prompt with tool definitions and a <User> / <Assistant calls the tool> / <Tool> dialogue and its [Answer] parser; AgentDoG uses its model-card trajectory prompt with [USER] / [AGENT] / [ENVIRONMENT] turns and a safe/unsafe output; Safiron uses its model-card guardian instruction with a JSON input of request, per-step actions and environment, harmless iff the output starts with “There are no risks”). Every verdict row records model id, prompt hash, token usage and latency. TS-Guard’s accuracy on the original wording (0.918) matches the released figure (0.917). The self-deployed Gemma 4 26B-A4B agrees with the managed one on 98.2% of verdicts on the original wording and 97–98% under the shared perturbed conditions, with a slightly lower false-positive rate (0.324 vs. 0.342); the two are reported as separate rows. blocks.zh: 所有守卫都在一个云平台上运行. 管理型号:双子座 3.8 Flash和双子座 3.1 Pro通过该平台的双子座API并带有响应计划; Claude Sonnet 5通过有思维障碍的合作伙伴API(SDK显示此模型没有温度); GLM 5.2, gpt-oss-120b, Gemma 4 26B-A4B和Llama 4 Maverick通过该平台的OpenAI兼容端点与响应_format = json_schema和8k头室符来隐藏推理. 自部署型号(Quen 3.8 27B FP8、Nemotron 3.5闪电30B-A3B、TS-Guard、6个小警卫、用于低资源对的Gemma 4 26B-A4B的自部署拷贝、3个专用卫士ShieldAgent、Safiron和Agent DoG在被绑的修改后)在1个RTX PRO 6000上运行,最大型号为32768、贪得分解和JSON-schema执行(TS-Guard使用其作者的XML即时和分解码器;ShieldAgent使用Agent-Safetty Bench评价即时附有工具定义和 " 用户称工具 " / " Tool " 对话及其[Answer]分解码器;Agent DoG使用其模式卡道道速用[USER]/[Agent]/[ENT]/[ENTRON]转弯并有一个安全/不安全输出;如果JSfiron使用其模式卡道卡守护 每个判决行记录模型id, 即时散列, 象征性的使用和延迟。 TS-Guard对原始措辞的准确性(0.918)与发布的数字(0.917)相匹配. 自行部署的Gemma 4 26B-A4B同意在98.2%的原措辞判决中管理一个,在共同扰动条件下管理一个97-98%,虚假阳性率略低(0.324对0.342);两者作为分行报告. 被管理的卫士:在0温下重复3个;安慰剂翻转率和重复到重复翻转率被报告为噪音地层. 总计算:API和GPU大约花费了1,460美元(934个令牌,105个GPU-hours),其中三分之一在认证出局时闲置了终点时间.
